tmp:2683: avukah shel or — a torch of light: parable-image for the talmid chakham who lights the way past thorns (tzome'ach) and pits (domem), punning avuk/attached to Torah's light
tmp:2684: she'erit — 'the remnant' of Micah 7:18, homiletically read as sherayim/leftovers: one who makes himself insignificant, for whom God passes over transgression
tmp:2685: shuruk — the Hebrew vowel-point of three dots (kubbutz form), symbolizing the three drops/three mochin descending from brain toward the kidneys
tmp:2687: telat mochin — the three brains/mentalities (kabbalistic mochin triad), paralleled to the three drops of the shuruk vowel and the seminal drop descending from brain to kidneys
tmp:2688: tam — 'wholesome/simple' as in 'Yaakov ish tam' (Gen 25:27), symbol of the inner intellect (sekhel) present in every thing
tmp:2689: hitlahavut ve-chamimut la-Shem — the state of burning enthusiasm and warmth toward God, kindled through bodily movement in devotion
tmp:2690: tenu'ah — physical movement/motion as the generator of spiritual heat (like friction melting wax), rooted in thought and arousing fervor for God
tmp:2691: the act of executing mishpat by rescuing the robbed from his robber — judicial rescue of stolen property (per Isaiah 1:17), which saves the victim's children's souls
tmp:2692: 'you do good for the children' — the beneficial effect on the sons/daughters (bechinat banim) achieved by performing justice and rescuing the robbed
tmp:2693: the principle that prayer depends on the heart — placing one's whole heart into tefillah, opposite of 'honoring with lips while the heart is far' (Isa 29:13)
tmp:2694: 'Tov Hashem la-kol' (Ps 145:9) — the verse-phrase 'God is good to all,' read as the aspect of prayer/faith that God alone supplies healing, livelihood, and everything
tmp:2695: shelom bayit as inner peace within one's own bones — harmony between one's body and soul, the prerequisite peace through which one merits prayer
tmp:2696: prita sifvateih — 'his lips move/are opened' (Talmudic phrase), read as the aspect of prayer per 'Adonai, open my lips' (Ps 51:17)
tmp:2697: Emor — the opening word 'Say [to the Kohanim]' (Lev 21:1), read as the aspect of prayer/declaration per 'et Hashem he'emarta' (Deut 26:17)
tmp:2698: the devotional practice of binding oneself in prayer to the tzaddikim of the generation, each of whom is an aspect of Moshe-Mashiach
tmp:2699: tefillah be-sekhel tzach — praying with a clear, lucid mind, attainable only after complete teshuvah removes the heart's foreskin
tmp:2700: the principle that prayer subsists in the air/atmosphere of Eretz Yisrael — standing (amidah) prayer as 'before Hashem your God,' i.e., the Land of Israel
tmp:2701: the teaching that a prayer fluent and pleasing in one's mouth is accepted — praying even without devekut, since fluency signals acceptance
tmp:2702: the task of elevating and rectifying speech (dibbur) — raising the word to its source (Malkhut-peh, the sea), prerequisite for attaining tefillin
tmp:2703: hitpa'arut shel Yisrael — Israel's glorying/adornment in God, identified with tefillin which are called pe'er (glory), source of fear falling on the nations
tmp:2704: tefillin shel HaKadosh Barukh Hu — God's own tefillin (Berakhot 6a), the aspect of God's glorification in Israel ('Who is like Your people Israel')
tmp:2706: the specific list of the Ten Psalms (16, 32, 41, 42, 59, 77, 90, 105, 137, 150) constituting Rebbe Nachman's Tikkun HaKlali
tmp:2707: the Tikkun HaKlali as 'a very very great remedy' for a nocturnal emission (mikreh lo tahor) — reciting the ten Psalms on the day it occurs
tmp:2708: tikkun ha-milah — the rectification effected by circumcision, the aspect of tikkun ha-brit; man created incomplete so as to perfect himself
tmp:2709: the action of bringing people back in teshuvah — 'extracting the precious from the vile' (Jer 15:19), itself a rectification for keri (seminal emission)
tmp:2710: tikkun ha-ka'as — the rectification of anger, accomplished through fasting; symbolized by chametz ('chamutz begadim' coming from Edom/the liver)
tmp:2711: the specific remedy of rectifying anger by means of fasting — subduing the liver/Edom heat through abstention from eating (chametz-aspect)
tmp:2712: tikkun ha-malkhut — the rectification of fallen Malkhut/kingship, returning it through fire ('pass it through fire') via verbal confession before the scholar
tmp:2713: tikkun ha-me'uvat — 'setting straight what is crooked,' the aspect of Yosef ('God has gathered [asaf] my disgrace,' Gen 30:23)
tmp:2714: tikkun ha-re'ut bi-shleimut — the complete rectification of eyesight/vision achieved on Shabbat (light restored by Kiddush after being diminished by large strides)
tmp:2715: tokpa de-dina — 'the intensity of judgment' (Aramaic), the harsh-judgment force of the kelipot linked to sadness ('vayit'atzev el libo,' Gen 6:6)
tmp:2716: shigyonot — 'errors/inadvertences' (Hab 3:1), the aspect of Targum/Tree of Knowledge: a mixture of good and evil like the inadvertent sin
tmp:2717: shogeg — the inadvertent sinner, whose deed is evil but intention good: a mixture of good and evil paralleling Targum and the Tree of Knowledge
tmp:2719: the state in which only fear of Heaven remains and no other fear — achieved by judging one's own affairs (mishpat), removing all mundane dreads
tmp:2720: yarka — 'vegetables/greens' (Aramaic), midrashically a symbol of teshuvah via 'vayarek et chanikhav'/orikan with Parashat Shoftim ('the fearful and fainthearted')
tmp:2721: 'kol ha-zove'ach et yitzro' — 'whoever slaughters his evil inclination' (with confession), the Talmudic phrase identified as the aspect of teshuvah
tmp:2722: teshuvah on one's first teshuvah — repenting over the earlier repentance itself, since even 'I have sinned' was said with ulterior motive
tmp:2723: teshuvah sheniyah — the second repentance (over the slaughter of the yetzer/first teshuvah), aspect of the honor of the World to Come outshining the first
tmp:2725: yarka shekul — 'weighed vegetables' (Aramaic idiom), symbol of teshuvat ha-mishkal: repentance calibrated in measure against the sin
tmp:2726: the word/utterance that issues in truth — 'the tevah (word/ark) going out be-emet,' whose 'opening is at its side,' drawing God to dwell with man
